youtube.description:
Build a Kiro skill in 5 steps (SKILL.md, Agent Skills)

Five steps to build your own Kiro skill.

1. Make a folder - One folder per skill.
2. Add SKILL.md - SKILL.md is the file Kiro reads.
3. Say when to use it - Give it a name and a clear description.
4. Write instructions - Spell out the steps Kiro should follow.
5. Call it by name - Type slash and the skill name.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/skills/

Which step surprised you? Comment its number. theAIgurukul posts a Kiro tip every day - subscribe.
